entry.title: Maulbronn Monastery

buildingCutout.basis: Individual current monastery footprints and building parts within the mapped heritage precinct. Public courts, paths, and nearby town buildings are retained.

entry.note: Maulbronn Monastery with the Cistercian church and ridge spire, open cloister and fountain house, west gate, Fruchtkasten granary, terracotta roofs, half-timbered courtyard houses and visible enclosure walls. The 264 m datum lies within the precinct. Foundation walls follow standard Terrarium, and the west gate leaves the mapped Klosterhof approach in place. Preview places the authored base at the recorded absolute sea-level elevation; local tide and terrain resolution remain host-dependent.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
